Subject: GCP Marketplace: procurement & PO onboarding for AstraSoft

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to proceed with listing on GCP Marketplace but need to align on procurement steps on our side (legal + finance). A few items we need help with: 

- Standard PO flow for GCP Marketplace purchases (how Redwood expects to receive POs and invoice cadence).
- Required onboarding evidence for vendor activation (tax forms, W-8/W-9, SOC2/Security artifacts).
- Any GCP-specific service-account or IAM expectations for private listing integrations.
- Timeline estimate for activation once docs + PO are submitted.

I attached a SKU list (Vendor-SKU-List.xlsx) and included our procurement alias above. Can you provide a short checklist and a single point of contact for finance/legal?

Appreciate it — would like to get this moving this week.

Best,

Hi Alex —

Adding a few GCP-specific notes and the practical checklist we use for vendor activation: 

- GCP integration artifacts: service account key (JSON) scoped to the minimal roles we specify (see attached template: gcp-service-account-template.json). We prefer customers to create a cross-project service account scoped to listing deployment; we do not ask for full org-level credentials.
- PO routing: your PO should reference the HubSpot deal id (AS-2027-047) and be emailed to finance@redwood.ai with copy to kimberly_park@redwood.ai. If you require a vendor portal upload, include the DocuSign/HubSpot link and we'll reconcile.
- Security evidence: we accept SOC 2 Type II report OR completed security questionnaire + compensating controls. 
- Timelines: Typical activation (once docs & PO received) = 3 business days for standard listings, 7–10 business days if legal review required.

Notes / Ask list for AstraSoft procurement: 
- Completed vendor packet (signed where indicated).
- PO referencing AS-2027-047, sent to finance@redwood.ai.
- SOC2 or filled security questionnaire (or letter from compliance).
- Service account JSON (use attached template) or confirmation you will use the UI-based onboarding flow.

If you want, Vanessa can run a short intake call to walk through the packet and verify attachments on the spot. 

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Marketplace Enablement Lead | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Alex / Procurement team —

Quick checklist from Finance/Legal to keep this moving: 

- Please complete the "Vendor Information" page in the attached packet and return as PDF.
- Provide a signed PO that includes the HubSpot deal id (AS-2027-047) and billing address: Redwood Inference, 2150 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94114.
- Upload your tax form (W-9 for US entities or W-8BEN-E for non-US). If you have a reseller agreement, include that too.
- If you cannot provide SOC2, complete the security questionnaire and we will accept compensating controls for initial activation.

Proposed times for a 30-min intake review call (PDT): Thu 3/31 10:00–10:30, Fri 4/1 09:00–09:30, or Fri 4/1 14:00–14:30. Reply with what works for you and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Kim
